阿姨.e: He stayed at his aunt's house.

邮件.s: 你收到了我发的邮件了吗？
邮件.p: Nǐ shōudào le wǒ fā de yóujiàn le ma?

叔叔.p: Wǒ míngtiān yào qù kàn wǒ shūshu.
叔叔.e: I am seeing my uncle tomorrow.

迟到.p: Tā shàngxué hěn kěnéng huì chídào.
迟到.e: He is likely to be late for school.

香蕉.p: Nǐ chī guò xiāngjiāo pài ma?
香蕉.e: Have you ever eaten a banana pie?

耳机.p: Měigerén dōu zài dài zhe ěrjī.

学期.s: 这个学期我们有两次考试。
学期.p: Zhège xuéqī wǒmen yǒu liǎng cì kǎoshì.
学期.e: We have two examinations during this term.

后天.p: Wǒ yào zài zhèlǐ dāi dào hòutiān.
后天.e: I'm going to stay here until the day after tomorrow.

路边.e: Don't just park along the road as you please.

西瓜.e: I love the taste of watermelon.

屋子.p: Nín zěnme ràng wūzi nuǎn qǐlai?
屋子.e: How do you heat the house?

外语.e: Chinese is harder than other foreign languages.

运动会.e: The athletic meeting will be put off.

衬衫.s: 他让他的妻子补好衬衫。
衬衫.p: Tā ràng tā de qīzǐ bǔ hǎo chènshān.
衬衫.e: He got his wife to mend his shirt.

行李.p: Qǐngwèn nín yǒu duōshǎo jiàn xíngli?
行李.e: How many pieces of baggage do you have?

东南.s: 浙江省地处中国东南沿海，隶属于华东地区。
东南.p: ZhèjiāngShěng dìchǔ Zhōngguó dōngnán yánhǎi, lìshǔ yú Huádōng dìqū.
东南.e: Zhejiang Province is located on the southeastern coast of China and belongs to the East China region.

脏.p: Bié yòng nǐ de zāng shǒu pèng zhège.
脏.e: Don't touch this with your dirty hands.

楼梯.p: Wǒ de fángzi yǒu liǎng zuò lóutī.
楼梯.e: My house has two flights of stairs.

起飞.p: Nà jià fēijī wǔ diǎn qǐfēi.
起飞.e: That plane will take off at five.

秋天.p: Qiūtiān de yuèliang shì měilì de.
秋天.e: The moon is pretty in the fall.

出院.s: 再过两周你就可以出院了。
出院.p: Zài guò liǎng zhōu nǐ jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
出院.e: In another two weeks you will be able to get out of the hospital.

过节.e: I'd like to go to Takayama during festival time.

画家.s: 他是个画家，但他不会画国画。
画家.p: Tā shì gè huàjiā, dàn tā búhuì huà guóhuà.
画家.e: He is a painter, but he can't paint in the traditional Chinese style.

筷子.p: Yì shuāng hóng kuàizi pò duàn le.
筷子.e: One pair of red chopsticks broke.

裙子.p: Wǒ de qúnzi bǐ wǒ jiějie duō.
裙子.e: I have more dresses than my sister.

留学生.s: 这间宿舍住着两个美国留学生。
留学生.p: Zhè jiān sùshè zhù zhe liǎng gè Měiguó liúxuéshēng.
留学生.e: Two American students live in this dorm.

羽毛球.s: 他们常在这儿打羽毛球。
羽毛球.p: Tāmen cháng zài zhèr dǎ yǔmáoqiú.

大熊猫.p: Dàxióngmāo zhǐ zhù zài Zhōngguó lǐ.
大熊猫.e: Giant pandas live only in China.

瓶子.p: Tā bǎ píngzi guàn mǎn le shuǐ.
瓶子.e: He filled the bottle with water.

打扫.p: Tā zài dǎsǎo tā de fángjiān.

菜单.p: Tāmen zài cāntīng lǐ kàn càidān.
菜单.e: They're at the eatery looking at the menu.

做客.p: Tā cháng lái wǒ zhè zuòkè.
做客.e: She often comes over to my place.

笔记.s: 我想借你的笔记用一下。
笔记.p: Wǒ xiǎng jiè nǐ de bǐjì yòng yíxià.
笔记.e: I'd like to borrow your notes for a bit.

草地.p: Wǒmen zuò zài cǎodì shàng ba.

放学.p: Tā yí fàngxué jiù huí sùshè le.
放学.e: He went back to the dorm as soon as he finished class.

箱子.p: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ xiāngzi liú zài zhèlǐ.
箱子.e: I want to leave this box here.

上衣.s: 我在找有我尺寸的上衣。
上衣.p: Wǒ zài zhǎo yǒu wǒ chǐcun de shàngyī.
上衣.e: I'm looking for a coat in my size.

四季.e: There are four seasons in one year.

工作日.s: 星期天不是我的工作日。
工作日.e: Sunday is not a workday for me.

开花.p: Guò liǎng sān tiān jiùyào kāihuā le.
开花.e: The blossoms will be out in a few days.

难看.s: 她穿着一条很难看的裙子。
难看.p: Tā chuānzhuó yì tiáo hěn nánkàn de qúnzi.
难看.e: She was wearing an ugly dress.

句子.p: Nǐ néng fānyì zhège jùzi ma?

护照.p: Nǐ yīnggāi dài hùzhào qù yínháng.
护照.e: You should bring your passport to the bank.

休假.e: I am taking tomorrow afternoon off.

请假.s: 我不知道他请假的原因。
请假.p: Wǒ bùzhī dào tā qǐngjià de yuányīn.
请假.e: I don't know the reason why he was absent.

课本.s: 我把课本翻到最后一页。
课本.p: Wǒ bǎ kèběn fān dào zuìhòu yí yè.
课本.e: I flicked through the textbook to the final page.

洗衣机.e: Something is wrong with the washing machine.

铅笔.s: 我能用一下你的铅笔吗？
铅笔.p: Wǒ néng yòng yíxià nǐ de qiānbǐ ma?
铅笔.e: Can I borrow your pencil for a bit?

照相.p: Zhè jià zhàoxiàngjī wǒ bù xǐhuan.

动物园.e: I went to the zoo yesterday.

渴.p: Wǒ hē shuǐ yīnwèi wǒ kě le.
渴.e: I'm drinking water because I'm thirsty.

认得.s: 房子里面的人我一个也不认得。
认得.p: Fángzi lǐmiàn de rén wǒ yìge yě bú rènde.
认得.e: I didn't recognize anyone in the room.

年级.p: Wǒ érzi shàng xiǎoxué sān niánjí.
年级.e: My son's in the third grade.

课文.p: Wǒ zuì tǎoyàn bèisòng kèwén le.
课文.e: What I hate most of all is having to recite texts from memory.

词典.s: 在你的词典查一查这个词。
词典.p: Zài nǐ de cídiǎn chá yì chá zhège cí.
词典.e: Look up the word in your dictionary.

黑板.p: Hēibǎn de jùzi bèi mǒ diào le.
黑板.e: The sentence on the blackboard was erased.

牙刷.p: Wǒ xūyào yì bǎ xīn de yáshuā.

一块儿.p: Zán yíkuàir lái chàng shǒu gē.

字典.s: 我能用一下你的字典吗？
字典.p: Wǒ néng yòng yíxià nǐ de zìdiǎn ma?
字典.e: Can I use your dictionary for a minute?

红绿灯.s: 到了红绿灯以后，往右拐。
红绿灯.p: Dàoliǎo hónglǜdēng yǐhòu, wǎng yòu guǎi.
红绿灯.e: After you get to the traffic lights, turn right.

冰激凌.e: Leave me a bit of ice cream.

雨衣.p: Nín zuìhǎo chuān yí jiàn yǔyī.
雨衣.e: You had better put on a raincoat.

聊天儿.s: 他们在一边吃喝，一边聊天儿。
聊天儿.p: Tāmen zài yìbiān chīhē, yìbiān liáotiānr.
聊天儿.e: They are eating and drinking while chatting.

别的.p: Wǒmen néng qù biéde dìfāng ma?

担心.p: Tā dānxīn tā kěnéng huì chídào.
担心.e: He's afraid that he might be late.

的话.p: Nǐ zhèyàng dehuà wǒ jiù zǒu le.
的话.e: If you're going to be like this, I'll just leave.

电子书.s: 你认为电子书会取代纸质书吗？
电子书.p: Nǐ rènwéi diànzǐshū huì qǔdài zhǐzhìshū ma?
电子书.e: Do you think that e-books will replace paper books?

发烧.e: I caught a cold, and I have a fever.

面前.p: Tā zài zhòngrén miànqián bèi cháoxiào.
面前.e: He was laughed at in public.

银行卡.p: Qiánbāo lǐ yǒu liǎng zhāng yínhángkǎ.
银行卡.e: There are two bank cards in the wallet.

周末.p: Nǐ de zhōumò shì zěnme guò de?
周末.e: How did you spend your weekend?
